name: mp-mcp
description: Live Materials Project data in Claude Code: every MP API endpoint, band structures, DOS, phonons, phase diagrams and MP's documentation, with a skill that knows which call answers which materials question

mp_api_key.title: Materials Project API key
mp_api_key.description: Your key from https://next-gen.materialsproject.org/api . Claude Code keeps it in your system keychain and sends it to the Materials Project MCP server with each request.

gnome_data.title: GNoME data
gnome_data.description: If your Materials Project account has GNoME data turned on (GNoME data may be used for non-commercial purposes only), which data should answers use? core: core Materials Project data only; to include GNoME data in an answer, ask for it in your question. always: include GNoME data whenever your account has it. both: give each count with and without GNoME data.
options: core (ask in your question to include GNoME)
both (will increase queries and time for responses)
gnome_data.default: core (ask in your question to include GNoME)
